subject: nice touches
author: drunknnumpty
body:
I tend to agree with Suf on this one.. although its not a burnout it certainly has some features that make it a nice stop gap before we visit Paradise..

Although I will return to Revenge or even Takedown when the mode takes me as there is no other game that has the feel or rush as burnout, Flatout will keep me occupied..

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
